copy.headline: Police, SWAT units responding after 1 shot by barricaded suspect in Arlington home
copy.caption:
Arlington Police are currently involved in a standoff with a barricaded suspect, and SWAT units are on-site to assist. The department responded to a call at around 1 p.m. of a shooting at the house.

When police arrived, they found a female victim with a gunshot wound. The victim said the man who shot her was inside the home.

story.title: Police, SWAT units responding after 1 shot by barricaded suspect in Arlington home
story.summary: Arlington Police are currently involved in a standoff with a barricaded suspect, and SWAT units are on-site to assist. ARLINGTON, Texas - Arlington Police are currently involved in a standoff with a barricaded suspect, and SWAT units are on-site to assist. Arlington Police are currently working on a barricaded suspect at a house on Templeton Drive. The department responded to a call at around 1 p.m. of a shooting at the house. When police arrived, they found a female victim with a gunshot wound. The victim said the man who shot her was inside the home. She was transported to the hospital. Arlington PD set up a perimeter around the house and are being assisted by the department's SWAT Team as they try to get the suspect to surrender.
